gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Nickerson has served continuously on the council since a Feb 8, 2011 special election (vice mayor 2017-2020, mayor since Nov 2020); Urbom since Apr 2019; Winters since Nov 12, 2024. The village website posts council minutes only from March 2017, so Nickerson's service from Feb 2011 to Feb 2017 (about 6 years) is not covered.

2017-2024 council records read from the village media library: verbatim transcripts (Full Moon Creative) from Sep 2017, summary minutes Mar-Jun 2017. Rolls are matched to the clerk's call order and checked against the clerk's announced tally; where an answer is [inaudible] the roll is marked partial.

No minutes posted (agenda only) for council meetings 2017-07-25, 2018-02-27, 2019-01-29, 2019-07-23, 2019-09-24, 2019-10-22, 2020-01-28, 2020-03-24, 2020-04-28, 2020-05-26, 2020-07-28, 2020-09-22, 2020-10-27, 2020-11-17, 2021-07-27, 2022-09-27 (regular), 2023-07-25, 2024-01-24; Feb 2017 and earlier meetings are not online at all. Private-party items from those agendas are listed with roll null; agendas from 2019-01-29, 2019-07-23, 2019-10-22, 2020-01-28, 2020-05-26, 2020-11-17 and 2023-07-25 carried no qualifying item. The 2021-03-23 minutes (file CouncilMeeting-Minutes-032321) were read: the Marlin Engineering traffic study was discussed but no contract vote was taken.

Many 2017-2020 agendas are scanned images; only the first 6 pages (the agenda cover) were read by OCR. Items whose vendor or applicant is not named in the agenda or the transcript (e.g. 2017 piggyback purchases, 2022 police vehicle and flooring items funded by grants, village manager/clerk/attorney employment items) are left out, as are interlocal agreements, budgets, millage and code ordinances.

Consent agendas: when the transcript shows a roll call on the consent agenda, that roll is applied to each private-party consent item; 2022-07-26 consent items (Shenandoah storm drain cleaning, David Plummer traffic study) passed by voice vote and carry no roll.
2024-10-22 G1 (Panizza Construction): the four members present each answered yes in the transcript, but the clerk announced "3-1"; the roll shows the recorded answers.

El Portal "minutes" are verbatim transcripts (Full Moon Creative) without item numbers at each vote. Rolls were matched to agenda items by address or keyword and by agenda order; matched rolls carry a note and should be checked against the meeting video. Where the match failed, roll is null
No minutes posted for 2025-11-18, 2025-12-09, 2026-03-24 or 2026-09-22; private-party agenda items from those meetings are listed with roll null
Meeting URLs point to the village meetings page with the file name as a fragment; the PDFs sit under wp-content/uploads/<year>/<month>/
Planning & Zoning board minutes (2025-01-21, 03-20, 06-24, 07-09, 10-28, 2026-01-22, 07-30) are a separate board and were not counted as council actions

Excluded under the standard: Miami-Dade interlocal agreements (legal notices, recycling), speed humps, advisory boards, landscaper/asphalt proposals that name no vendor, FOP police contract, village manager hiring and contract, elections and millage
Consent agenda (including the Osuna Ornamental Fences proposal) passed 3-0 but the transcript does not identify the three voters; roll null
